note.message: mamelet on node web runs 0.9.2, which does not carry out the linux extension (mamelet 0.10.0 and later do): Mamela gives the node nothing of it
note.hint: update mamelet on web first, to 0.10.0 or later: put it at the site's controlplane.mamelet_binary, declare it with Mamela.mamelet and apply (docs/mamelet-update.md; a Control Plane is updated before its mamelets); then plan again
